title: Omea - a game where you can literally say anything to NPCs. No dialogue wheels. Just type what you want. Here's the demo trailer.
author: Crunchfest3
selftext:
Our friends at AImmersive created OMEA.   
  
OMEA is interactive fiction where you type your choices in natural language — no predetermined options. The AI was trained exclusively on novels (155k+) to understand narrative structure, not just conversation. It maintains persistent memory across the whole adventure, so cause-and-effect actually works the way it should in a good story.   
  
Adventures are written by human storytellers — the AI handles what a human writer can't track alone: thousands of player decisions and their downstream effects.   
  
Free to play at [https://omea.ai/](https://omea.ai/) — would genuinely love feedback from people who actually care about interactive fiction
